name: Hexagon Stained Glass Suncatcher
description:
KEY FEATURES

  • Premium Material:
    - Crafted from high-quality stained glass material, offering a vibrant, elegant, and artistic decorative finish.
    - Features a beautiful hexagon shape that creates a timeless and eye-catching window hanging display.
    - Product thickness: 4mm, providing a sturdy and durable structure while still allowing light to shine through beautifully.
    - Designed with a dark outline frame that helps enhance the stained glass artwork and gives the piece a refined finished look.
    - Comes with a hanging chain for convenient display and a suction cup for easy window mounting.
    - Ready to hang and perfect for adding a colorful, light-catching accent to any space.

 

  • Sizes & Dimensions:
    - Available sizes:
                                +) 15.11 x 13.14 cm ~ 5.95 x 5.17 in.
                                +) 11.14 x 9.65 cm ~ 4.39 x 3.8 in.
    📌 Note: The shape is fixed and cannot be changed. Customers may customise only the printed design.

 

  • Printing Technology:
    - Printed using advanced UV printing technology for vibrant colors and sharp details.
    - Single-sided printing optimized to enhance the stained glass effect when sunlight passes through.
    - The printing process ensures high-definition artwork, long-lasting color, and resistance to fading.

 

  • Functional & Usage:
    - Functions as both a decorative window hanging and a personalized keepsake.
    - Designed to catch sunlight and create a beautiful visual accent in your home.
    - Ready to hang with the included chain for quick and easy display.
    - Can be attached to windows or smooth surfaces using the included suction cup.
    - Suitable for living rooms, bedrooms, kitchens, offices, sunrooms, or gift displays.

 

  • Perfect Gift for Any Occasion:
    - A meaningful personalized gift for family members, friends, coworkers, and loved ones.
    - Perfect for birthdays, anniversaries, housewarmings, and special celebrations.
    - Ideal for pet lovers, nature lovers, memorial gifts, and home décor enthusiasts.
    - A thoughtful keepsake for Mother’s Day, Father’s Day, Christmas, and holiday gifting.
    - Great for adding a colorful and sentimental touch to windows, walls, and personal spaces.
    - Brings warmth, beauty, and a heartfelt decorative accent to any home 🎁

 

SPECIFICATION

  • Processing Time: 1 – 3 working days on average after payment and all designs updated correctly
  • Shipping Time: 6 – 9 working days on average (US)
  • Packaging: 1 x Hexagon Stained Glass Suncatcher

 

PRODUCTION

  • The tracking Country Origin is the US

Print Guidelines

Below is our complete selection of art templates used for designing within the full printable area of our products. Each template comes with a .png detailing Safe Area, Bleed, etc. Download templates and mockups here

 

To use an Art Template:

  • Open the Printway template for your selected product in Photoshop or another design program.
  • Insert your artwork in a new layer, placing all important parts of your design within the designated “Safe zone” on the art template to ensure your design will not be cut off during the printing process.
  • If you’re designing drinkware, use the indicated centering lines to ensure your artwork is placed exactly where you’d like.
  • Hide or delete the Art Template layer from your file.
  • Save as a .png, .jpg, or another accepted file type.
  • You’ve now used a Printway template to create artwork exactly to the recommended specs for that product.

 

To ensure your design prints properly on each product:

  • Ensure all important elements of your design are within the safe zone on the product template.
  • Fill the entire design template! The outer edge of the template represents “Bleed Area,” which signifies the areas which may print on the outer edges of your product.
  • Failure to fill the bleed area will likely result in unprinted white unprinted areas around the edge of your product.
